claims: Selection Sunday for the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's and Women's Basketball Tournaments is Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men’s bracket will be revealed at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Women’s bracket will be announced at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
The 68-team fields for the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's and Women's Basketball Tournaments are revealed, including seedings and first-round matchups.
The tournament officially begins with the First Four games on March 17-18, 2026.
